title: Mughal Economy Overland Trade
definition: The complex network of trans-continental caravan routes connecting the Mughal Empire with Central Asia, Persia, and the Ottoman Empire, facilitating the exchange of luxury goods, bullion, and horses.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding India's integration into the early modern global economy, the role of the 'Bullion-for-Goods' cycle, and the geopolitical significance of the Northwest Frontier.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Mughal Economy Overland Trade.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
